Instead, he was cast in a “rich family parent-child life swap” reality show.
What Bo Yiming expected from the entertainment industry; reveal his hidden identity as a rich heir, show off some cool dance moves, toss a wink here and there—fans would swoon and worship him.
What Bo Yiming actually got; being bossed around by Little Daddy on national TV to farm, weed the fields, and spray pesticides.
Fans in the livestream chat.
“AHHHHH Wen Cishu is so freaking gorgeous! Bo Yiming, move it—go plant rice, don’t block my view of your Little Daddy!”
Bo Yiming, “Where’s my textbook? This young master is aiming for Tsinghua or Peking University!”
⸻
Wen Cishu had always thought Bo Tingyuan only married him out of duty, due to their parents’ past entanglements. That misunderstanding had weighed on his heart for years.
But after awakening, he learned—
The cold and distant man he called his husband… had loved him deeply all along.
They’d slept in separate beds for years—not out of apathy, but because Bo Tingyuan thought his health was too fragile.
He avoided talking work—because he didn’t want to stress him out.
The horribly cheesy red roses he got every holiday? Not ordered by his assistant—personally chosen by Bo Tingyuan.
Wen Cishu, “If you’re not gonna use that mouth to speak, donate it to someone who will!”
associated_names: 偏执反派的小爸爸觉醒后

113311.synopsis:
Recently, a trending topic shot to the top of the cosmic charts:
“Hot topic — the whole world is speaking Chinese!”
Everyone got curious. Turns out, someone was live streaming to promote the Chinese language — and the results were surprisingly good.
But why promote Chinese to that planet?
Come on, they’re still monkeys! Why bother those poor animals?
The guy’s already got a gun to his head — is this really necessary?
Still, the donations were pouring in like never before.
A Long glanced at the comments and the screen full of virtual gifts, speechless and looking to the heavens:
“Why are my fans so two-faced?”
The top donor’s username was short and to the point:
“Goldpatron.”
It was thanks to this sponsor’s massive donation that A Long’s stream skyrocketed to #1.
Looking at all those zeros, everyone was stunned by the sponsor’s generosity.
There was just… so… many… zeros — people started getting other ideas.
“Maybe the sponsor has a crush on A Long? Is that why they’re throwing money like that?”
A Long had accepted a mission:
Promote the Chinese language to the entire world.
She was forced to start streaming.
But why spread Chinese to an uncivilized alien planet?
The mission itself felt shady and totally unreasonable — like someone was just trying to mess with him.
But there was no backing out after accepting it.
Luckily, a lot of rich sponsors liked watching her “spread civilization” and started showering her with money.
A Long’s personality was pretty much: “muddle through life, eat, wait, and die.”
So once she got the sponsor’s cash, she started living it up like crazy.
That money seriously upgraded her whole lifestyle.
But once A Long had everything, she started feeling a little lost.
After partying to exhaustion, she eventually returned to her original mission — spreading Chinese to the world.
When a sponsor gets rich enough, their mindset evolves.
They start doing charity, supporting national campaigns, that kind of thing.
So this particular sponsor became interested in what A Long was doing.
“I like your stream,” they said — even though A Long hadn’t actually started teaching any Chinese yet.
She still got a massive sum of money upfront.
Even when A Long was just goofing off, doing nothing but enjoying herself, the sponsor didn’t mind.
After all, when you have too much money, you just want to see what someone can do with it.
Maybe that’s what rich people find entertaining.
And of course, after that, the sponsor was glued to A Long’s stream every day — constantly sending gifts.
You could say that A Long completing her mission wouldn’t have been possible without the sponsor’s enthusiastic support.
Well, and maybe the system’s random babbling helped a little too.
As for what happened between A Long and the sponsor later on…
associated_names: 金主疯狂为我打钱为哪般
金主瘋狂為我打錢為哪般

114847.synopsis:
Ceres, a magic swordsman treated like dead weight in his adventuring party, is finally kicked out by none other than the Hero and party leader, Zect.
Even his childhood friends all sided with Zect, leaving Ceres with nowhere to turn.
But here’s the twist: Ceres is actually a reincarnated soul from another world, far older than he appears, and being banished didn’t faze him as much as one might expect.
And what happens next? Well… you’ll have to read to find out.
associated_names: 勇者に全部奪われた俺は勇者の母親とパーティを組みました！！　セレスの新たな物語

118175.synopsis:
Chou Bodeng transmigrated, becoming the number one profligate dandy in the novel *Chronicles of the Gods*.
This dandy was fair-skinned and beautiful, stunning in his red robes. Relying on his absurdly high seniority in the sect, he raised hell and caused trouble wherever he went.
And in the end, he got himself killed.
Logically, upon receiving such a script, one should behave, live virtuously, and then ride the protagonist’s coattails for support.
However, Chou Bodeng did the math and discovered that from the start of the story to the day he’d get killed off… there were a full eight! hundred! years!
—He could live an unbridled, joyful life for eight hundred years, and they wanted him to bow and scrape?
No way, no way. He was done playing nice.
And so, the Taiyi Immortal Sect discovered that their Young Ancestor had gotten even worse.
One day, he was roasting Elder Jun’s phoenix.
The next, he was fishing out Elder Ye’s Kunpeng.
The day after that…
The day after that, he went down the mountain all by himself!
The entire sect: “Holy shit! Is our Young Grand-Uncle going to get himself killed on the very first day?”
Not only did the Young Grand-Uncle not get killed, but he thrived, making a motley crew of friends from across the Three Realms:
The son of the Medicine Valley’s Master, who couldn’t heal a soul;
The miserly bastard from the Shanhai Pavilion;
The degenerate from the Buddhist Sect who refused to help the poor;
The oddball from the Ghost Valley who knew nothing of divination…
Later on, even the righteous and upright protagonist was led astray.
The Number One Profligate Alliance burst onto the scene.
Everyone thought the Three Realms were done for.
Until the day the Great Desolation emerged and the Heavenly Dao collapsed.
The Medicine King’s son poisoned ten thousand demons, the good-for-nothing from the Beast Taming Sect transformed into an Azure Dragon, the degenerate from the Buddhist Sect unleashed the Nine-Revolution Bodhi…
And as for the Alliance’s number one profligate, Chou Bodeng—
Clad in red, with a single strike of his sword, he sundered the primordial chaos.

118943.synopsis:
She was born with a household registration in the capital. Her looks made her the flower of the alley. The boys chasing after Xu Meng could line up all the way down the street, but fate took a sharp turn in the year of her college entrance exam.
She failed the exam. Her mother died unexpectedly. She faced setbacks at every turn in her job search…
It wasn’t until right before her death that she found out: her admission notice had been taken by someone else, the demolition compensation for the old house had been stolen, and even her mother’s death was shrouded in suspicion. Someone had lived an easy, lucky life using her name.
When she opened her eyes again, she was back in that familiar alley, back in that rundown siheyuan, surrounded by noisy neighbors. Looking at the calendar on the wall that read 1990, she realized she had returned to the summer before her college entrance exam.
This time, Xu Meng would walk out of that house with her mother…
Tags: Farming life, Transmigration into a book, Satisfying storyline, 1990s era, Lighthearted
Core message: Stay positive and keep moving forward.
associated_names: 九零小巷来了个大美人

120223.synopsis:
After reincarnating as a petite fox girl, Su Tianqing becomes a mysterious villainous magical girl, embarking on a daily life of picking fights with the righteous magical girls.
Tentacle monsters? The natural enemy of magical girls! Max them out!
Masked villains? Also the natural enemy of magical girls! Max them out!
Not enough magical girls? No problem! Watch as I trick clueless girls into joining the dark side!
Publicly exposing identities? Let’s not do that.
Finally, one day, when the villainous magical girl is surrounded by the righteous ones, the sly young fox panics.
“W-What are you doing?! Don’t pull my tail! Stay away, ahhh!”
associated_names: 反派魔法少女，每日任务就是找茬

120735.synopsis:
Hard times call for recycling tr*sh.
The world’s going to hell, and there are never enough heroes.
“…So, who’d you say was on this mission?”
Doesn’t matter what kind of tr*sh—monster, villain, petty thief, con artist, even a rabid dog.
“Welcome to the Black Parade.”
Day after day, they throw convicts onto the battlefield.
For justice, peace, love, and… for freedom!

124063.synopsis:
Ji Yan has been put through three “showdowns between the real and fake young masters”.
When he was the real young master, the fake young master was pure and everyone’s favorite. He went on to inherit the family business, while the real young master died miserably.
When he was the fake young master, the real young master was self-reliant, being admired by everyone. He eventually inherited the family business, while the fake young master died miserably.
In short, they were both miserable deaths.
Ji Yan: “…”
This time, he transmigrated as a real young master again. Ji Yan collapsed to the ground. If there’s anyone out there who wants to be the real young master, they can have it. I quit!
What’s more, his starting point this time was a major bomb. 
The fake young master is called Ruanruan. He has soft collarbones, a delicate and rosy face, speaks softly, and is spoiled to death by his three brothers.
Ji Yan: The game’s already lost to start with.
Instead of wasting his time on fighting for favor, he might as well go clean the village toilets. Before his miserable death comes, he will do something he loves.
……
And so, a top star was born in the entertainment industry.
When Ji Yan’s background was revealed, fans said, “Thank you, Ji family, for not recognizing our idol.”
associated_names: Zhè háomén zhēn shàoyé wǒ bùdāngle [yúlè quān]
这豪门真少爷我不当了[娱乐圈]
這豪門真少爺我不當了[娛樂圈]

126623.synopsis: The most terrifying thing in this world is the everyday life of a human being.

131487.synopsis:
The apocalypse arrived overnight, zombies rampaged, creatures mutated, and the world became increasingly strange. 
Giant pythons over a hundred meters long, giant crocodiles tens of meters long… 
This world seemed to have become an alien planet. 
Fortunately, Jiang Wu possessed an unreliable System. Even if this System was unreliable, it truly gave Jiang Wu powerful strength. When others were still fearing zombies, he had already launched an attack on a giant crocodile tens of meters long! 
When others were still struggling, he was already lying in the lap of a beautiful woman, controlling the City! 
When others were still struggling to survive in the corner, he was already riding a Giant Bird, going wherever he wanted! 
In the end, Jiang Wu discovered that he had become the global ruler. And his woman and his faction were incredibly strong. 
PS: This is the story of a “Little Person” who, in the Doomsday, relies on an unreliable System to build the strongest faction from scratch.
associated_names: 都末世了，人生躺平系统才来？

132511.synopsis:
Corporate drone Jiang Ci was playing a mobile game about managing a hotpot restaurant on her day off when she was unexpectedly s**ked into the game, finding herself in a desolate, post-apocalyptic world.
The game system informed her that by completing system tasks and upgrading her hotpot restaurant, she could earn her own hotpot restaurant in the real world.
Reject the corporate grind, take control of her destiny!
However, the luxurious five-story hotpot restaurant in the game had turned into a dilapidated wooden hut with only two shabby tables and chairs inside.
Even the variety of dishes and soup bases was pitifully limited.
Jiang Ci was dumbfounded. How was she supposed to play this?
The system then began issuing tasks: “Serve five customers to unlock mineral water.”
“Sell ten portions of potatoes to unlock beef slices.”
Jiang Ci’s gaze fell on the empty, zombie-infested world outside the hut: “…”
*
Song Jinchuan was trapped in a room surrounded by hundreds of zombies after trying to save someone. On the brink of death, he was suddenly transported to a shop filled with the aroma of hotpot.
A beautiful young girl in front of him happily threw him a rag, “You came at the right time! Want to be a waiter? Food and lodging included!”
Song Jinchuan, holding the rag, stood frozen in place: “…” Is heaven… this competitive?
(A very unconventional post-apocalyptic story, slow-paced, daily life progression~)
Theme: With enough effort, success is possible.
associated_names: 在灾难世界经营火锅店

144031.synopsis:
【A ruthless, crazed educated youth x a defiant and untamed young wolf】
An era-based revenge novel filled with satisfying face-slapping and cruelty toward scum. Explosively thrilling.
She was a top boss of the apocalypse, yet upon entering the book she fell straight into hell.
Xu Zhili opened her eyes to find herself in the body of a cannon-fodder girl with the same name, living in the staff housing compound of a machinery factory in 1968.
Her beginning was a dead end. Her biological father, Lin Jianguo, was worse than scum. He reported his first wife and had her sent to the cowshed just to climb upward at work. Her stepmother took over the home, and the stepmother’s freeloading daughter stole her job and seized her fiancé, then even wanted to force her to die.
Xu Zhili laughed. Perfect.
That very night, the Lin household was emptied out. Not a single tile remained, and even the mouse holes were scraped clean.
She took her young brother and went to the countryside to search for their mother.
In the Great Northern Wilderness, she encountered the wolf cub, Xie Yunce.
She fought wild boars with her bare hands, intimidated villains, and protected her family.
He moved in the darkness, clearing obstacles for her and weaving an underground web.
She used her spatial ability and apocalyptic knowledge to exchange for high quality seeds and improve farming tools. From small items like wristwatches, radios, and tractors to large machines such as fighter jets, tanks, and aircraft carriers, she handed everything over to the nation, allowing the country to rise to the peak of the world.
As for him, with exceptional courage and mastery over black market rules, he quietly laid the foundation for a vast economic empire as the tide of reform began to surge.
The fire of revenge burned through heaven and earth.
Lin Jianguo, who abandoned his wife and daughter, finally landed in prison, reviled by tens of thousands. The stepmother and stepsister ended up like stray dogs.
When that economic godfather, the wildest and most untamable man at the forefront of the era, pinned the supposedly cold-hearted young lady of the Xu family tightly against a haystack and bit at her ear, forcing her to take responsibility, the wind and snow of the harsh Great Northern Wilderness bore witness.
In the fierce wind and snow of the Great Northern Wilderness, the prairie fire belonging to them had only just begun to ignite.
associated_names: 穿书六零：疯批知青不好惹

163487.synopsis:
Reincarnation into another world – those words made my heart beat faster, and I nodded without thinking. I accepted the goddess’ invitation without a second thought, hoping for the continuation of my dream.
However, when I was reincarnated, I was Bahamut.
The strongest species spoken of in mythology. The king of the sky. A symbol of destruction and the end.
Even with such power, the goddess had only one mission for me.
“Watch over the world, please.”
… I prepared myself, knowing that something must be happening.
However, the world was – too peaceful, almost tranquil.
There was no war or conflict, and everyone was smiling …
associated_names: バハムート宇宙を行く

169887.synopsis:
Ke Bu thought that after all these years, he should have gotten used to Zhi Li by now.
He was wrong.
Now in university and already firmly entangled in each other’s lives, Ke Bu and Zhi Li continue their wonderfully abnormal relationship—surrounded by troublesome friends, ridiculous bets, jealousy, family complications, and all the chaos that seems to follow them wherever they go.
Loving Zhi Li may have become second nature to Ke Bu. Understanding him, however, remains another matter entirely.
After all, Lord Zhi Li has always been far too difficult to understand.

193951.synopsis:
Wei Jun confirms that if he gets killed, he’ll become invincible, so he starts recklessly courting death. Then he discovers this world is toxic.
The Emperor: “Back when the immortal sects lorded over the imperial court, tyrannizing everyone, every official in the palace, including myself, groveled before the immortals. Only Wei Jun had the courage. Facing death as if returning home, he cursed me in front of everyone for disgracing the dignity of the throne, and even declared outright: so long as the immortals live, the great thieves will never cease. In that moment, I resolved that a loyal minister like this must be protected at all costs.”
The Cursed Maiden: “The immortals said I was a Death Star incarnate, that wherever I went, death followed like a shadow. I upheld justice impartially, yet was despised for bringing misfortune. I selflessly helped so many people, but when I fell on hard times, all I received was the condemnation of a thousand pointing fingers. Until Wei Jun appeared. He told me I had done nothing wrong and that he wasn’t afraid to die. Even if nothing but darkness remained in my life, he was willing to burn his own life as a lamp to shine its light upon me, so I could see the light again. For such immense kindness, this humble girl has no way to repay him… except with her hand in marriage. Dear Wei, you simply must not refuse.”
The Demon Lord: “When I first met Wei Jun, he was still weak and insignificant, while I was the peerless Demon Sovereign hunted by the Upper Realm. I told him: saving me means making enemies of all the gods, you will die. Wei Jun just smiled and said, ‘If I die, I die. What’s there to fear?’ I have roamed this world unmatched my entire life, and I’ve seen through the cruelty of mortals and the hypocrisy of gods and immortals. Only after meeting Wei Jun did I finally learn that this world truly does have heroes who face death without flinching.”
Wei Jun: “I just want to die. Why is it so damn hard?”
associated_names: Gentleman Wei Who Sees Death as a New Beginning
Shi Si Ru Gui Wei Junzi
Wei Junzi, Who Faces Death Without Fear

200863.synopsis:
Joy of Reunion 《Xiang Jian Huan》is a massively popular, high-freedom Danmei harem game where players can choose to experience the story from either the Emperor’s Route or the Consort’s Route.
If you choose the Emperor’s Route, you are the supreme ruler above all. Three thousand beauties are yours to choose from, life and death are at your command, and you can flip whoever’s name tag you want or bestow death upon anyone you please.
If you choose the Consort’s Route, you start from the lowest tier as a mere male favorite. Whether you choose to live a life free of conflict in a quiet corner, or ruthlessly eliminate all rivals to monopolize the imperial favor—the choice is entirely yours.
On both paths, the number-one antagonist is the high-ranking NPC, Lu Xuechao. In the Emperor’s Route, if you don’t grant him your exclusive love, he will commit regicide. In the Consort’s Route, the Emperor is completely obsessed with him in the early game. Consequently, players on the Emperor’s Route banish him to the cold palace and sentence him to death right at the start, while players on the Consort’s Route do everything in their power to scheme against him and bring about his demise.
However, one day, the game’s Emperor—who was supposed to be controlled by the players—suddenly developed a consciousness of his own.
Players on the Consort’s Route were shocked to discover that no matter how they set traps or framed him, and no matter how many times they reloaded their saves, the Emperor remained fiercely and exclusively devoted to Lu Xuechao, completely ignoring the consorts controlled by the players.
Players on the Emperor’s Route were even more devastated—the game options completely vanished! They could only watch helplessly as the Emperor ran over to Lu Xuechao’s palace time and time again, while conveniently sending the three thousand court beauties out of the palace one by one.
